name: Telegram iOS Design System — Mini App & Admin

meta.source: Telegram iOS (Day / Night) defaults, Telegram Mini Apps themeParams, community file 'Telegram Design System' for reference

color.note: Semantic tokens. In a Mini App each token is overridden at runtime by the matching --tg-theme-* variable (see README → Theme binding). Hex values here are the iOS Day / Night defaults and the fallback for the web admin.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Telegram logo blue. Cover, splash, marketing only — never for UI controls (use accent).

tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Grouped screen background behind sections (settings-style screens, admin page). = secondary_bg_color.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Plain (non-grouped) screen background: chat lists, full-bleed content. = bg_color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section / cell / card background on page-bg. = section_bg_color.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, popovers, dropdowns.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: Translucent navigation bar and admin top bar. = header_bg_color.

tokens.name: bottom-bar-bg
tokens.usage: Tab bar, bottom button area. = bottom_bar_bg_color.

tokens.name: cell-highlight
tokens.usage: Pressed / hovered cell or table row background.

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Search field, segmented control track, gray buttons.

tokens.name: chat-bg
tokens.usage: Chat wallpaper stand-in behind message bubbles (message editor preview). Approximation of the Classic wallpaper.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, page-bg. = text_color.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Readable secondary text: cell values, table secondary columns, admin descriptions, search placeholder. ≥4.5:1 on surface and page-bg in both themes. = subtitle_text_color.

tokens.name: text-hint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, captions, disabled text. FLAG: 3.3:1 on surface (light), 2.8:1 on fill-tertiary — Telegram's own value; never for text the user must read to act. = hint_color.

tokens.name: section-header
tokens.usage: Uppercase 13px section headers and footers on page-bg (4.6:1 light, 5.2:1 dark). = section_header_text_color.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in text and in message bubbles. = link_color.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Filled / main button fill, selected tab, focus ring. = button_color. FLAG: on-accent text is 4.0:1 (light) and 3.5:1 (dark) — Telegram's own pair; keep button labels ≥15px semibold.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. = button_text_color.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text: plain buttons, cell actions ('Добавить'), selected states. = accent_text_color. 4.0:1 on surface (light): use at 15px+.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent text on accent-tint and small (12–14px) accent text in the admin: 4.9:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted button fill, selected row, accent status tag background.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive cell actions ('Удалить'), destructive dialog buttons, error borders. = destructive_text_color. FLAG: 3.6:1 (light) / 3.9:1 (dark) on surface — Telegram's own value; 17px only, small text uses destructive-strong.

tokens.name: destructive-strong
tokens.usage: Small error text (field errors, table status), text on destructive-tint.

tokens.name: destructive-tint
tokens.usage: Error banner and 'failed' tag background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Switch on, success icons, chart 'up' fills. Not for text on light (2.2:1).

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Success text: 'Оплачено', '+12%', tag text on success-tint.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: 'Paid' / 'Sent' tag background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons, pending dots. Not for text on light.

tokens.name: warning-strong
tokens.usage: Warning text: 'Ожидает', 'Запланировано', tag text on warning-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: 'Pending' / 'Scheduled' tag background.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 0.5px hairlines between cells, table rows, under nav bar. = section_separator_color.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off. 3.0:1 (light) / 3.4:1 (dark) against surface, so the off state reads as a control, not as empty space.

tokens.name: switch-on
tokens.usage: Switch track when on (iOS green). Alias to accent if the product prefers accent switches.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast / snackbar fill in both themes; text on it is on-toast.

tokens.name: on-toast
tokens.usage: Text and icons on toast-bg.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: Incoming message bubble (bot messages in the editor preview).

tokens.name: bubble-out
tokens.usage: Outgoing message bubble. Approximates the Classic theme.

tokens.name: bubble-meta
tokens.usage: Time and checkmarks inside bubble-out.

tokens.name: keyboard-btn-bg
tokens.usage: Inline keyboard buttons under a message. Text on it is accent-strong.

tokens.name: on-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text on an accent-strong fill (primary inline button). 5.8:1 light, 9.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-success-strong
tokens.usage: Text on a success-strong fill (success inline button). 5.4:1 light, 10.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-destructive-strong
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive-strong fill (danger inline button). 5.4:1 light, 9.2:1 dark.

tokens.usage: Settings-row icon tile (squircle) fill. White glyph on top.

tokens.usage: Settings-row icon tile fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Roboto Mono", monospace

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: First screen title under the nav bar.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles on web.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Nav bar title, main button label, emphasized cell title.

styles.name: admin-page-title
styles.usage: Page title in the admin top bar.

styles.name: admin-body
styles.usage: Default admin text, form fields, sidebar items.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Promo codes, IDs, payment references, code entities.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding, hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in tags, tab icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls, bubble inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell vertical padding, gap between avatar and text, card gap in admin grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Cell horizontal inset, section side inset, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap above a section header.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Admin card padding, gap between admin sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section-to-section gap on grouped screens, admin page side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status tags, format-bar buttons, settings icon tiles (29px squircle uses 7).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, sidebar items, inline keyboard buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Grouped sections, inputs, search field, medium buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Main button, admin cards and tables.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs (iOS alert).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles (the tail corner uses radius-xs).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, badges, pill buttons, switches.

tokens.name: size-nav-bar
tokens.usage: Navigation bar height (without status bar).

tokens.name: size-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height (without home indicator).

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: Single-line cell min height.

tokens.name: size-cell-subtitle
tokens.usage: Cell with subtitle or 40px avatar.

tokens.name: size-main-button
tokens.usage: Main (bottom) button height.

tokens.name: size-button-md
tokens.usage: Medium button, admin primary button.

tokens.name: size-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small pill button inside cells and tables.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Avatar in list cells and tables.

tokens.name: size-icon-tile
tokens.usage: Settings icon tile.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Admin sidebar width.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Admin cards on page-bg (dark relies on surface contrast).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, segmented-control thumb is lighter.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch knob and segmented-control selected segment.
